headline: 🔥 Palo Alto Zero-Day RCE, 🎯 Iran Oman Espionage, 🛡️ Argo CD Secrets Leak, 💀 QLNX Dev RAT, 🔓 Azure AD Bypass
summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS zero-day (CVE-2026-0300) under active exploitation with no patch for 7+ days affects 5,800+ exposed firewalls. Argo CD critical auth bypass (CVE-2026-42880, CVSS 9.6) exposes Kubernetes Secrets. New QLNX Linux RAT targets developer supply chains with rootkit and PAM backdoors. Iranian operators breach 11 Omani government entities. Azure AD phantom device registration bypass detailed. Patch Palo Alto User-ID portals immediately, upgrade Argo CD, and audit Entra ID Conditional Access policies.
